questions.q: Where does Peter say he was with Jesus when the voice came out of heaven?
How does Peter describe the person who lacks these qualities?
options: Blind, seeing only what is near

questions.q: Peter tells readers to heed the word of prophecy as if it were what?
options: A lamp shining in a dark place
A sword that divides the heart
A seed planted in good soil
A rock that cannot be moved

questions.q: What does Peter call his body, which he says he will soon put off?
For we didn't follow ____ when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Be more diligent to make ____ sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.
That through these you may become ____, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
Peter says prophecy of Scripture came by the will of holy men.
The voice Peter heard said, "This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."
What has God's divine power granted to us?
options: All things that pertain to life and godliness
Riches and honor in this world

questions.q: If these qualities abound in you, what do they keep you from being?
In Peter's list of qualities, what is added last, to brotherly affection?
For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into ____ of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
Knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of ____.
Peter says he and those with him were eyewitnesses of Christ's majesty.
Peter says he will stop reminding the readers, since they already know these things.
Whose way does Peter say the false teachers followed, loving the wages of wrongdoing?
In Peter's example, what stopped the madness of the prophet?
options: A speechless donkey speaking with a man's voice
An angel standing in his path

questions.q: According to Peter, whom do the false teachers deny?
Where does Peter say God cast the angels who sinned?
The dog turns to his own vomit again, and the sow that has washed to ____.
These are ____, clouds driven by a storm.
Promising them liberty, while they themselves are ____.

items: God did not spare the angels who sinned
A flood brought on the ancient world
Sodom and Gomorrah turned into ashes
Righteous Lot delivered from the wicked

questions.q: Peter says that for those who escape the world's defilement and are entangled again, the last state is worse than the first.
Peter says angels bring slanderous judgments against dignitaries before the Lord.
What will the false teachers secretly bring in?
How does Peter describe Noah?
What distressed righteous Lot?
options: The lustful life of the wicked

questions.q: Because many follow the false teachers' immoral ways, what happens to the way of the truth?
Enticing unsettled souls, having ____, accursed children!
The Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous ____ for the day of judgment.
Peter says the false teachers count it pleasure to revel only in secret at night.
How does Peter say the day of the Lord will come?
options: As a thief in the night
After a sign in the heavens

questions.q: What do the mockers in the last days ask?
options: Where is the promise of his coming?
Who has ever seen the Lord?
When will the heavens be opened?

questions.q: Why does Peter say the Lord is not slow concerning his promise?
options: He is patient, wanting all to come to repentance
He is waiting for the nations to gather
He is still preparing his angels
He is waiting for the temple to be rebuilt

questions.q: Which beloved brother does Peter say wrote letters with some things hard to understand?
But, according to his promise, we look for ____, in which righteousness dwells.
questions.answer: new heavens and a new earth
wrong: a kingdom that cannot be shaken
the rest promised to the fathers

questions.q: But grow in ____ of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been ____.

items: Remember the words of the holy prophets
The world then perished, overflowed with water
One day is with the Lord as a thousand years
Beware lest you fall from your steadfastness

questions.q: Peter says this is the second letter he has written to these readers.
Peter tells his readers to regard the patience of the Lord as a sign of delay.
On the day of the Lord, what will happen to the earth and the works in it?
What do the mockers of the last days walk after?
What do the ignorant and unsettled do with things that are hard to understand?
options: Twist them to their own destruction

questions.q: Be diligent to be found in peace, ____ in his sight.
What kind of people ought you to be in ____?
Peter says the mockers carefully remember that the earth was formed by the word of God.
Peter tells readers to look for and earnestly desire the coming of the day of God.
